ai_passages.ai_start: Generative AI tools can provide plausible text or code, but they do not replace your learning.
ai_passages.ai_end: you will hardly be able to blame AI for a failure at your future workplace.

courses.note: The page says two sections run independently with different instructors; only Section B's public site was found. The fa2025 course-site URL returned only a generic Grainger placeholder page.

The BS in Computer Science lists no required software engineering or capstone course. CS 222 Software Design Lab (1 credit) is required but is a lab, not a software engineering course. A team-project course must be taken as a technical elective (CS 411, CS 428 and others), so none is a fixed requirement.
